thread.title: Dow logs 190-point gain, but tech stocks cap broad-market climb ahead of midterm elections - MarketWatch

author: Mark DeCambre
title: Dow logs 190-point gain, but tech stocks cap broad-market climb ahead of midterm elections - MarketWatch
text:
U.S. stocks on Monday finished the session mostly higher but weakness in the technology and internet-relate sectors limited an advance in the broader market. Monday's moves come ahead of highly anticipated midterm elections on Tuesday, which are likely to shift the congressional balance of power, a key factor in the outlook for stock investors. The Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, +0.76% gained 190 points, or 0.8%, at 25,461, while the S&P 500 index SPX, +0.56% ended the session with a gain of 0.6% at 2,738, while the technology-laden Nasdaq Composite Index COMP, -0.38% closed down 0.4% at 7,328. In corporate news, a decline in shares of Apple Inc. AAPL, -2.84% continued to a weigh on the market after the company late-Thursday said it would stop disclosing unit sales of many of its key products. Contributing to the iPhone maker's woes were reports that it had curbed plans for additional iPhone XR production lines. Separately, shares of Amazon.com Inc. AMZN, -2.27% were in focus after the Wall Street Journal reported that the tech giant plans to split its second headquarters evenly between two locations rather than picking one city. On the data front, data from the Institute for Supply Management showed that nonmanufacturing slipped to 60.3 in October from 61.6 in September, but beating the 58.6 average estimate of economists surveyed by MarketWatch. Readings of at least 50 indicate improving conditions.
